description.narrative: (Tanzania): &amp;amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;amp;gt;With FY 2022 funds, USAID will improve tuberculosis (TB) screening, diagnosis, and treatment for infants, children, and adolescents at two centers of excellence in the Mwanza and Mbeya regions. Focusing on family-based, comprehensive pediatric and HIV care, the centers emphasize mitigating mother-to-child transmission of HIV by supporting orphans and the most vulnerable children, girls and young women, and adolescents transitioning to adulthood. By integrating services, management, organizations and cadres of care for TB alongside the center's HIV services, USAID will deliver the right activities in the right context. Specific efforts will include scaling up Isoniazid Preventive Therapy, orienting community health service providers on home-based TB screening and contact tracing, procuring medical supplies to facilitate TB diagnosis, and forming Multi Drug Resistant TB (MDR-TB) treatment clubs for children and adolescent receiving Directly Observed Therapy and maintenance anti-TB drugs...
